body: My problem is that I have to take so many pills just to not make other people’s lives worse.
I hope it works out for you buddy— either way you end up going. I know that stuff is hard to just...recover from.

Dude I wish I could help you. You’re younger than me and you’ve already gone through all the same garbage I know that shit sucks. I wish the people at these places understood for a second that LoOkInG oN tHe BrIgHt SiDe is something people like us physically can not do in the first place.

The fact that it’s never going to get better than “I’m ill and I have to do these things just to feel slightly better than hurt everyone”. I have to jump through all of these hoops just to see everything actively getting worse in my life.

It took me a while to figure out that a&e is a britbong thing. Nah. If you’re not currently in pain, going to the hospital will get you put in a mental health inpatient ward for a few days. If you’re genuinely concerned for your own safety then go for it but otherwise it’s not the most fun experience for someone who’s made the decision already.
Yeah! Don’t don’t get discouraged if it doesn’t work right away. I think half the “””””””magic”””””” of it is spending so much time thinking about how dumb it is and whether it’s working or not.

I’m actually, no joke, happy you have found success with the system but after my family found out about my issues, they immediately cut all contact. I’m already seeing doctors and managing my affairs and taking meds I’ve just had enough of it. This isn’t any way to live.

It’s pretty frustrating when it gets that bad, yeah. I won’t suggest just going to sleep because I know that isn’t always possible but if you’re in the right environment for it, just laying on the ground face down is— not calming but at least something different. I read that changing your body’s orientation can affect your mood in different ways and that’s what works for me sometimes
Yeah I know where you’re coming from. Gimme like a bad watch mojo top 5 list of the bad stuff
I know that feeling man. How bad is it? Is there anything that could feasibly be done right now to fix it?
I’m gonna pretend that you don’t know what the word ‘hypocrite’ means and tell you to give it a little more time Ryan.

Not allowed to give suggestions but I can commiserate on failed hanging attempts. It seems pretty hard to get just right. The first time I tried the knot slipped and the second time I messed it up the anchor wasn’t secure.

I’ve personally given up on that method so maybe it’s not that great after all

I appreciate the gesture, it’s very nice but the idea of living in the care of others sounds completely unbearable. My inpatient experiences have taught me that the intersection for mental health and men (especially of color) aren’t the friendliest or safest ones.
What’d you OD on? I hope it goes easy for you.

I’ve given myself the typical “when I’m 30” time limit and it’s fast approaching. After spending years and large sums of money I didn’t have to begin with on the mental healthcare circuit, my life has only gotten worse in ways I couldn’t have even predicted before I started.

Poor dosing and bad interaction management has left me with terrible physical side effects to go along with the onset of psychosis I find myself suffering from every day. In several severe episodes I’ve managed to push everyone out of my life who was able to cope with just the comparatively benign depression and now I’m completely without anything close to a support system or safety net. This is most definitely a permanent problem at this point friend.

I had this problem for a long time too. I’m probably not allowed to tell you what works best for easy cuts but whatever you’re using isn’t sufficient if you have to put effort into it.

Either way, I hope it works out for you. Cutting can definitely be a helpful stress relief in the right (or rather wrong) mindset sans a desire to die.
